verses.en: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits: he set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verses.sm: Nepukanesa Na faia e Nepukanesa le tupu o le tupua auro, e onogafulu kupita o lona umi lea; e ono kupita o lona lautele lea; na ia faatuina i le fanua laugatasi o Turu ile itu malo o Papelonia.

verses.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king sent to gather together the princes, the governors, and the captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.sm: Ua tuu savali e Nepukanesa le tupu ia faapotopotoina alii sili, o faipule, o e pule i nuu, o faamasino, o e tausi tupe, o e popoto i tulafono, o e faamatala tulafono, atoa ma faipule uma o itu malo, ia o mai i le faasaina o le tupua na faatuina e Nepukanesa le tupu.

verses.en: Then the princes, the governors, and captains, the judges, the treasurers, the counsellors, the sheriffs, and all the rulers of the provinces, were gathered together unto the dedication of the image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.sm: Ona potopoto mai ai lea o alii sili, o faipule o e pule i nuu, o faamasino, o e tausi tupe, o e popoto i tulafono, o e faamatala tulafono, atoa ma faipule uma o itu malo, ua o mai i latou i le faasaina o le tupua na faatuina e le tupu o Nepukanesa; ona latou tutu ai lea i luma o le tupua na faatuina e Nepukanesa.

verses.en: Then an herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, O people, nations, and languages,
verses.sm: Ona alaga atu lea o lē tala‘i ua leo tele, O le upu ia te outou nuu e, ma atu nuu. ma gagana eseese.

verses.en: That at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king hath set up:
verses.sm: Se itu aso tcu te lagona ai le leo o le pu, le faaili, le kitara, le sapeka, le saniteri, Je sumefono, atoa ma laaupese uiga eseese uma, tou te faapauu ai rna ifo i le tupua auro ua faatuina e le tupu o Nepukanesa.

verses.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth shall the same hour be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.sm: Ai se tasi e le faapaù ma ifo e lafoina O ia i lea lava itu aso i totonu o le ogaumu e mu ai le afi.

verses.en: Therefore at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and all kinds of musick, all the people, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, ua oo ina lagona e tagata uma Je leo o le pu, le faaili, le kitara, le sapeka, le saniteri, atoa ma laaupese uiga eseese uma, ona faapauu ai lea o nuu uma, ma atunuu, ma gagana eseese, ua latou ifo i le tupua auro na faatuina e le tupu o Nepukanesa.

verses.en: Wherefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and accused the Jews.
verses.sm: Ona o ane ai lea o tagata Kaletaia ua latou momoli i sa Iutā.

verses.en: They spake and said to the king Nebuchadnezzar, O king, live for ever.
verses.sm: Ua latou tautala atu, ua faapea atu i le tupu o Nepukanesa, Le tupu e, ia soifua oe e faavavau.

verses.en: Thou, O king, hast made a decree, that every man that shall hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, shall fall down and worship the golden image:
verses.sm: Le tupu e, na faia e oe le tulafono i tagata uma ia faapauu ma ifo i le tupua auro pe a lagona le leo o le pu, le faaili, le kitara, le sapeka, le saniteri, le sumefono, atoa ma laaupese uiga eseese uma lava.

verses.en: And whoso falleth not down and worshippeth, that he should be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.sm: Ai se tasi wa le faapaú ma ifo, e lafoina o ia i totonu o le ogaumu o mu ai le afi.

verses.en: There are certain Jews whom thou hast set over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; these men, O king, have not regarded thee: they serve not thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
verses.sm: O i ai tagata o sa Iutā, o e na. tofia e oe e pule i sauniga o le itu malo o Papelonia, o Sataraka, o Mesako, ma Apeteniko; le tupu e, ua le ava ia tagata ia te oe, latou te le auauna i ou atua, ua le ifo foi i latou i le tupua auro ua e faatuina.

verses.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar in his rage and fury commanded to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. Then they brought these men before the king.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Nepukanesa ma le lilivau ma le ita tele ia taʻitaʻiina mai Sataraka, ma Mesako, ma Apeteniko. Ona latou taʻitaʻiina ai lea o ia tagata i luma o le tupu.

verses.en: Nebuchadnezzar spake and said unto them, Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, do not ye serve my gods, nor worship the golden image which I have set up?
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Nepukanesa, ua faapea atu ia te i latou, Sataraka e, Mesako e, ma Apeteniko, pe se matua manatu ea tou te le auauna i oʻu atua, ma outou le ifo i le tupua auro na aʻu faatuina?

verses.en: Now if ye be ready that at what time ye hear the sound of the cornet, flute, harp, sackbut, psaltery, and dulcimer, and all kinds of musick, ye fall down and worship the image which I have made; well: but if ye worship not, ye shall be cast the same hour into the midst of a burning fiery furnace; and who is that God that shall deliver you out of my hands?
verses.sm: O lenei, afai ua saunia outou pe a outou lagona le leo o le pu, le faaili, le kitara, le sapeka, le saniteri, le sumefono, atoa ma laaupese uiga eseese uma, tou te faapauu ma ifo i le tupua ua aʻu faia, e lelei; a e afai tou te le ifo, e lafoina outou i lena lava itu aso i totonu o le ogauma e mu ai le afi; o ai foi se Atua na te laveaiina outou ai lau pule?

verses.en: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, answered and said to the king, O Nebuchadnezzar, we are not careful to answer thee in this matter.
verses.sm: Ua tali mai Sataraka, Mesako, ma Apeteniko, ua faapea mai i le tupu, Nepukanesa e, e le aoga ona matou tali atu ia te oe i lenei mea;

verses.en: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of thine hand, O king.
verses.sm: afai o lea, ua mafai lo matou Atua, matou te auauna i ai, ona laveai mai ia te i matou ai le ogaumu e mu ai le afi, na te laveaiina mai lava i matou ai lau pule le tupu.

verses.en: But if not, be it known unto thee, O king, that we will not serve thy gods, nor worship the golden image which thou hast set up.
verses.sm: A e peitai, a le o lea, ia e silafia e oe le tupu e, matou te le auauna i ou atua; o le tupua auro foi ua e faatuina, matou te le ifo i ai.

verses.en: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
verses.sm: Ona tumu ai lea o Nepukanesa i le ita tele, ua ese le tu o ona fofoga ia Sataraka, ma Mesako, ma Apeteniko; ua tautala atu ia, ua faapea atu, ia faaaasa le ogaumu, ia faafitu ona sili i le ua masani ai ona tafuina.

verses.en: And he commanded the most mighty men that were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia i tagata E sili ona totoa i ana “au latou te fusifusi ia Sataraka, ma Mesako, ma Apeteniko, ia lafoina i le ogaumu e mu ai le afi.

verses.en: Then these men were bound in their coats, their hosen, and their hats, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.sm: Ona fusifusia ai lea o ia tagata, atoa ma O latou ofuvae, ma o latou ofu tino, ma o latou ofu talaloa, atoa ma o latou ofu, ma ua lafoina i totonu i le ogaumu e mu ai le afi.

verses.en: Therefore because the king's commandment was urgent, and the furnace exceeding hot, the flame of the fire slew those men that took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.
verses.sm: Ua tauanau le poloaiga a le tupu, ma le ogaumu ua aasa tele lava, o le mea lea na fano ai i le mumu o le afi o ia tagata e na avae ia Sataraka, ma Mesako, ma Apeteniko.

verses.en: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.sm: A o ia tagata e toatolu, o Sataraka, o Mesako, ma Apeteniko, ua pauu i latou o fusifusia i totonu o le ogaumu e mu ai le afi.

verses.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astonied, and rose up in haste, and spake, and said unto his counsellors, Did not we cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? They answered and said unto the king, True, O king.
verses.sm: Ona matuá ofo ai lea o Nepukanesa le tupu, ua vave ona tulai, ua fai atu, ua faapea atu i ana tulafale, Pe na tatou le lafoina ea tagata e toatolu o fusifusia i totonu o le au? Ua tali mai i latou, ua faapea mai i le tupu, Le tupu e, sa faapea lava.

verses.en: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God.
verses.sm: Ua tali atu o ia, ua faapea atu, Faauta, ua ou iloa tagata e toafa, ua tatalaina, ua feoai i totonu o le afi, ua le afaina lava i latou; ua tino mai lona toafa ua pei o se alo o le Atua.

verses.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the mouth of the burning fiery furnace, and spake, and said, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, ye servants of the most high God, come forth, and come hither. Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, came forth of the midst of the fire.
verses.sm: Ona faalatalata atu lea o Nepukanesa i le gutu o le ogaumu e mu ai le afi, ua fai atu ia, ua faapea atu, Sataraka E, Mesako, ma Apeteniko, o auauna a le Atua silisili, o mai ia, ina o mai. Ona o mai ai lea o Sataraka, Mesako, ma Apeteniko mai totonu o le afi.

verses.en: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king's counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopotoina ai lea o alii sili, o faipule, o e pule i nuu, atoa ma tulafale a le tupu, ua latou matamata i ia tagata ua le mafaia i le afi ona muina o latou tino, e leai foi so latou lauulu ua mu, e lei liua foi o latou ofuvae, ua le namu au lava i latou.

verses.en: Then Nebuchadnezzar spake, and said, Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who hath sent his angel, and delivered his servants that trusted in him, and have changed the king's word, and yielded their bodies, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Nepukanesa, ua faapea atu, la faafetaia le Atua o Sataraka, Mesako, ma Apeteniko, o le na auina mai lana agelu, ua laveaiina ai ana auauna e na faatuatua ia te la, ua liliuina foi le upu a le tupu, ma ua latou tuuina atu o latou tino ina ne“ latou auauna ma ifo i se tasi atua, tau lava o lo latou lava Atua.

verses.en: Therefore I make a decree, That every people, nation, and language, which speak any thing amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made a dunghill: because there is no other God that can deliver after this sort.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te pule ai, Ai se nuu, po o se atu nuu, po o se gagana ese, na te faia se upu vale i le Atua o Sataraka, Mesako, ma Apeteniko, e vaevaeniniiina i latou, e fai foi o latou fale ma faatáfuna; aua e leai se isi atua na te mafaia ona laveaiina faapena.

verses.en: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, in the province of Babylon.
verses.sm: Ona tomai lea o Sataraka, Mesako, ma Apeteniko i le itu malo o Papelonia, i le pule a le tupu.
